summary: FASE U UI Testing: Tested dual-unit functionality (roll + yard/kg/panel) across Purchasing, Purchase Requisitions, and Orders views. Backend POC 63/63 green, gate.sh --full 100% green (already verified). This iteration focused on UI-level verification of the dual-unit feature.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking '+ Buat' button on Purchasing view does not open the PO creation form/modal. Button appears to change state but no form is displayed. This prevents automated testing of U-US1 (Create PO with dual units).
ui_bugs.impact: Cannot test PO creation with dual units through UI automation. Manual testing may be required to verify U-US1.
ui_bugs.notes: The button may open a dropdown menu or the form may load asynchronously. The form with data-testid='create-po-form' was not found after clicking. This could be a timing issue or the button behavior is different than expected.
